content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh may increase, decrease or cancel the notified vacancies at any stage of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AP High Court Civil Judge LDCE 2026?
content_sections.text: Only serving officers in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division) under the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service can apply. The candidate must have completed at least three years of service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) by 31 March 2026 .

content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate seeking accelerated promotion to Civil Judge (Senior Division) through the LDCE must: Be serving as a Civil Judge (Junior Division) in the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service. Have completed not less than three years of service in that cadre by 31 March 2026. Possess the necessary educational and service qualifications prescribed under the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service rules.

content_sections.heading: Disqualification Conditions
content_sections.text: The following officers are not eligible to apply: An officer facing disciplinary charges. An officer undergoing punishment for any irregularity in the discharge of duties. An officer whose integrity has been found doubtful in any year.

content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process may include the following stages: Computer-based screening test, if required Written examination Viva voce Document verification

content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Screening Test Pattern
content_sections.text: The High Court may conduct a computer-based screening test depending on the number of applications received. The screening test marks will be used only for shortlisting candidates for the written examination. These marks will not be added to the final selection marks.

content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Written Examination Pattern
content_sections.text: The written examination consists of three papers. Each paper carries 100 marks and has a duration of three hours. Questions must be answered in English, except for the translation portion of Paper-III. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks separately in each part of Paper-III. Marks obtained in Paper-III will not be counted for determining eligibility for viva voce or final selection.

rows.subject: Translation from English to Telugu and Telugu to English

content_sections.heading: Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: To qualify for the viva voce, candidates must obtain: At least 55% marks in Paper-I. At least 55% marks in Paper-II. At least 60% aggregate marks in the written examination. At least 40% marks separately in each part of Paper-III.

content_sections.heading: AP High Court Civil Judge Viva Voce
content_sections.text: Candidates who remain absent from the viva voce will be disqualified from the selection process. No travelling allowance or daily allowance will be paid for attending the screening test, written examination or viva voce.

rows.details: Three candidates for every available vacancy
60% in the written examination and viva voce

content_sections.heading: Final Merit List
content_sections.text: The final merit list will be prepared using marks secured in Paper-I, Paper-II and viva voce. Paper-III marks and screening test marks will not be added to the final merit score. If two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference will be decided in the following order: Candidate older in age Candidate possessing a higher educational qualification Candidate securing higher marks in the prescribed educational qualification

content_sections.text: Candidates must enclose attested copies of the following documents with the application: Date of birth or SSC certificate Law degree certificate Other educational certificates Community certificate for SC and ST candidates claiming reservation Service certificate in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division) Appointment order as Civil Judge (Junior Division) Demand Draft for the applicable examination fee Hall ticket-cum-identity card in original and duplicate Recent passport-size photograph attested by the concerned Unit Head or Principal District Judge All original certificates must be produced for verification on the date of viva voce.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The AP High Court has announced 16 Civil Judge (Senior Division) LDCE vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only serving Civil Judges (Junior Division) in the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service who have completed at least three years of service by 31 March 2026 can apply.

faq.question: Q3. Can advocates or fresh law graduates apply?
faq.answer: No. This is a departmental accelerated promotion examination and is not open to advocates, fresh law graduates or candidates outside the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the concerned Principal District Judge by 5:00 PM on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the Civil Judge Senior Division salary?
faq.answer: The post carries a pay scale of Rs.1,11,000 to Rs.1,63,030.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1,000 for Open, EWS and BC candidates and Rs.500 for SC, ST and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a computer-based screening test, if required, followed by a written examination and viva voce.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline using the prescribed application form and submit it through the concerned Principal District Judge's office.
